With an estimated marine fisheries potential of 58.6 lakh MT within its EEZ, the sector plays a vital role in sustaining the livelihoods of nearly 50 lakh fishers, while contributing significantly to food security, nutrition, employment, income generation and export earnings.

India today ranks among the leading fisheries and aquaculture producing nations globally, with seafood exports valued at around ₹73,890 crore during FY 2025-26, underscoring the sector’s growing importance in the national economy and global seafood trade.
